rate_table_note: Rates are in 31.13.01.10A(1) to (3). Joint coverage of a husband and wife is at most 1.80 times the single life premium (B); not published as a figure, so not recorded. Other policy types and rating methods need the Commissioner's approval and must be actuarially consistent (C). Chapter history: .10 has not been amended since the chapter revision effective March 1, 2001 (27:22 Md. R. 2062). Also saved: archive/MD/2026-11-21_2756d5ab.html (MD-COMAR-31.13.01.html).
source_title: COMAR 31.13.01.10 Prima Facie Premium Rates for Credit Life Insurance (Library of Maryland Regulations)
summary: Rates in force: Maryland's prima facie credit life rates in COMAR 31.13.01.10: $0.43 per annum per $100 single premium decreasing term, $0.66 per month per $1,000 outstanding balance, and $0.71 per annum per $100 single premium level term, single life. The regulation says they apply to all premiums charged on or after March 1, 2001.
